title: Personalized Federated Direct Preference Optimization via LoRA Adapters
abstract: arXiv:2610.12885v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated Direct Preference Optimization (FedDPO) enables privacy-preserving alignment of language models across distributed agents without centralizing sensitive preference data. However, existing FedDPO analysis assumes all clients converge to a single shared policy, which is fundamentally at odds with the heterogeneous preference distributions present in practice. We propose Personalized FedDPO (pFedDPO), in which each client maintains a small private LoRA adapter atop a shared global base model. In pFedDPO, the base model is synchronized via FedAvg each round, while LoRA adapters remain local and capture client-specific preference patterns. We prove that this decomposition replaces the gradient diversity $\kappa^2$ in the FedDPO bound with a residual heterogeneity $\kappa^2_{\mathrm{eff}}$, which is no larger than $\kappa^2$ when adapters absorb client-specific directions, at the cost of an additive adapter-bias term that vanishes as

translated_title: 基于LoRA适配器的个性化联邦直接偏好优化
translated_abstract: 联邦直接偏好优化使分布式智能体能够在无需集中敏感偏好数据的情况下，以保护隐私的方式对语言模型进行对齐。然而，现有的FedDPO分析假设所有客户端收敛到一个单一的共享策略，这与实践中存在的异构偏好分布从根本上相矛盾。我们提出了个性化联邦直接偏好优化（pFedDPO），其中每个客户端在共享的全局基础模型之上维护一个小的私有LoRA适配器。在pFedDPO中，基础模型每轮通过FedAvg进行同步，而LoRA适配器保持本地化并捕获客户端特定的偏好模式。我们证明，这种分解将FedDPO理论界中的梯度多样性κ²替换为残余异构性κ²_eff，当适配器吸收客户端特定方向时，κ²_eff不大于κ²，其代价是引入一个额外的适配器偏差项，该项会随着（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 提出pFedDPO方法，让每个客户端在通过FedAvg同步的共享全局基础模型上保留本地LoRA适配器以捕获个性化偏好，从而将FedDPO理论界中的梯度多样性项κ²替换为更小的残余异构性项κ²_eff。
en_tdlr: Proposes pFedDPO, where each client keeps a local LoRA adapter atop a FedAvg-synchronized global base model to capture personalized preferences, replacing the gradient diversity term κ² in the FedDPO bound with a smaller residual heterogeneity term κ²_eff.
